basic_profile.bio: Based in Portland, Oregon, I'm a 41-year-old software engineer with a keen interest in mental health advocacy. My journey with bipolar disorder has led me to explore various online communities for support and shared experiences. I work mostly from home, allowing flexibility in my schedule, and I often spend evenings and weekends online. I am single, enjoy hiking in the Pacific Northwest, and have a soft spot for indie films. My dislikes include crowded places and noisy environments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a minor in Psychology, my expertise spans both technology and mental health. I've self-taught myself cryptocurrency trading and am involved in the tech startup scene. My understanding of mental health has been enriched through personal experience and active engagement in communities like r/bipolar.
